recovery.title: Owned recovery example
recovery.help: This example changes no files. Confirm to make the review action available, or cancel to dismiss it.
recovery.notice: Confirm the example dialog, then review its result.

notification.overflow: More notifications are waiting. Review the related views for details.

app.title: Plugin Shell
app.intro: A working foundation, not another blank canvas. Explore the services behind this view, then make them your own.
app.scope: Reusable authoring, optional examples and explicit Markdown or plugin-data persistence. Native/device and release acceptance remain separately qualified.

overview.title: Everything is connected.
overview.subtitle: Real components. Real services. Your Obsidian theme.
overview.safe: Nothing is written to your vault until you review and confirm.

cards.documentsText: Validate a Task, preview its frontmatter, then create one complete note.
cards.eventsText: Watch committed facts flow between services without a global singleton.
cards.feedbackText: Field errors stay with the form. Native notices remain deliberate.
cards.themeText: Scoped component styles follow the host’s colors, type and spacing.

overview.flowText: The same services run inside Obsidian and in the browser harness. Only the host adapters change.

doc.title: Create a Task document
doc.subtitle: The Markdown file is the record. There is no duplicate Task database.
doc.label: Title
doc.empty: Your Markdown preview will appear here.
doc.emptyText: Enter a title and preview the exact content and destination.
doc.note: Existing notes are never overwritten. Preview does not create files or folders.
doc.browserNote: Harness mode: notes are stored in this browser’s synthetic vault, not a real Obsidian vault.

repo.title: Your Task notes
repo.help: Read and edit notes in your Task folder. Handwritten content and other properties are preserved.
repo.initial: Load your Task notes to view or edit them.
repo.empty: No Task notes in this folder. Create one above, then reload.
repo.saved: Task changes saved. The note path and handwritten content are unchanged.
repo.confirm: Move “{title}” to the vault trash? Reload notes to review the latest content before deleting.
repo.stale: Your draft is retained. Reload notes to discard it and review the current note before editing again.

events.title: See the wiring work
events.subtitle: Events carry facts. Commands perform actions. Every subscription has an owner.
events.empty: No events yet. Publish one or create a document.
events.safety: Payloads are not included in diagnostic logs. Closing a view removes its listeners.
events.expected: This is a deliberate feedback example. Your data has not changed.

settings.title: Make it feel at home
settings.subtitle: The same preferences are available in Obsidian’s native plugin settings.
settings.languageHelp: Updates the view immediately. Registered command labels update after a plugin reload.
settings.folderHelp: A vault-relative folder, for example Tasks or Projects/Tasks.
settings.noticesHelp: Also show a native notice after successful document creation.
settings.themeHelp: No independent color mode is installed. Components consume the host’s CSS variables.
settings.blocked: Stored plugin data could not be safely read, or a save could not be confirmed. Saving is disabled to preserve the data. Resolve the issue and restart the plugin before making further changes.
settings.recoveryCorrupt: Stored plugin data is invalid. It has been preserved and saving is disabled. Restore a reviewed backup or repair the data while the plugin is disabled, then restart.
settings.recoveryFuture: Stored plugin data uses a newer schema. It has been preserved and saving is disabled. Use a plugin version that supports this data; do not replace it with defaults.
settings.recoveryInaccessible: Plugin data could not be read. Saving is disabled. Check access and storage availability, then restart after resolving the read failure.
settings.recoveryUncertain: The last save outcome is uncertain. Further writes are blocked. Inspect the saved data before restarting and deliberately continuing; do not retry blindly.
settings.hideHeaderHelp: Applies immediately to all Plugin Shell views. Restore it here, in native settings, or with the command palette.

feedback.native: This notice came through the host adapter.

modal.confirmText: This example changes no documents. Confirm or cancel to inspect the typed outcome.
modal.promptText: Enter a short value. It stays in this example and is never written to your vault.
modal.title: One view, two environments
modal.text: This dialog uses the Obsidian Modal API in the plugin and an isolated browser adapter in the harness. The application services do not depend on either implementation.

debug.title: Debug report
debug.enabled: Debug logging enabled for this session.
debug.disabled: Debug logging disabled. Error diagnostics remain active.

error.commandUnavailable: This command is not available in the current context.
error.title: Enter a title with 1–120 characters.
error.filename: Use a nonblank note title without / \ : * ? " < > |, control characters, a leading dot, a trailing space or dot, or a reserved device name. The title must fit a 255-byte filename including .md.
error.tags: Use up to 12 short tags with letters, numbers, hyphens or slashes.
error.folder: Use a safe relative folder without hidden names, traversal or special filename characters.
error.settingsRead: Stored plugin data is protected. Resolve the read error before saving.
error.settingsWrite: The save outcome is uncertain. Saving is disabled until the plugin restarts and reads the stored data.
error.pluginDataRead: Stored entity data is invalid or uses an unsupported schema. It has been preserved without changes.
error.pluginDataMissing: This entity no longer exists. Reload the collection before continuing.
error.pluginDataConflict: An entity with this ID already exists. No entity was overwritten.
error.pluginDataLimit: Plugin data exceeds its supported size, record count or revision limit. No changes were saved.
error.pluginDataStale: This entity changed or its snapshot belongs to another runtime. Reload and review it before saving.
error.conflict: The destination already exists. No file was overwritten.
error.write: The note could not be saved. Check the destination and permissions.
error.read: The note could not be read. Check that it exists and is accessible, then reload notes.
error.duplicateIdentity: Two notes share the same entity ID. Resolve the duplicate before editing; no notes were changed.
error.repositoryLimit: This folder exceeds the 1,000-note inspection limit. Use a smaller dedicated folder.
error.uncertain: The write result is uncertain. Check the exact destination before trying a new submission.
error.open: The note is created, but could not be opened. Retry opening; do not create it again.
error.stale: This preview no longer matches the request or destination. Prepare a new preview.
error.disposed: This view has closed. Reopen the showcase.
error.request: Invalid submission identity. Prepare a new preview.
error.entity: The entity definition is invalid or unavailable.
error.sessionLimit: This session reached its 100-preview limit. Reopen the plugin before preparing more.
error.unexpected: An unexpected error was contained. Check the diagnostic panel.
error.render: This view encountered a rendering error. Close and reopen the view. Your documents are unchanged.

items.title: Plugin-data items
items.help: Keep a small list in plugin data. Items do not create or change vault notes.
items.reloaded: Items reloaded. Your drafts are retained; review the current label before saving.
items.invalid: Enter a label with 1–120 characters after trimming spaces.
items.labelHint: 1–120 characters. Spaces at the beginning and end are removed.
items.empty: No items yet. Add your first item above.
items.deleteHelp: This permanently removes the selected item from plugin data. It cannot be restored from the vault trash.
items.pending: Waiting for this action to finish…
items.stale: Your draft is retained. Reload items and review the current label before saving again.
